summary: Full e2e verification of the Regime-Lab job controls (pause/resume/stop/cancel/reset) and Bitunix precision fix. Backend: 28/28 unit tests pass across /app/tests/test_bitunix_qty_whole_units.py, test_regime_lab_job_controls.py, test_regime_lab_closed_buckets.py and /app/backend/test_bitunix_precision_fix.py (with test_get_mark_price_live deselected). Live-API checks: all 4 control endpoints return 401 without token and 404 with admin token on unknown job ids; POST /api/regime-lab/reset returns {status:'reset', cleared:int}. Real regime-opt run against existing analysis ra_f64533ae (ctrl-test3), regime 2 (Seitwärtsmarkt, share 37.3%), mode=combo, deep_test=true: pause -> paused=true, phase prefixed '⏸ Pausiert', progress frozen (22->22), paused_total_s grew 0->5.2->9.3; resume -> paused=false, progress advanced (22->38); stop -> status=done, phase='Fertig (Suche vorzeitig beendet – Bestes behalten)', result.stopped_early=true, no 'Datensatz nicht reproduzierbar' error. Notfall-Reset: started separate job, active endpoint showed it running, POST /reset cleared=1, active=null, job status became cancelled. Frontend: Admin-Login -> Tools -> Regime-Lab overlay; clicked existing analysis ctrl-test3, opened regime-optimize-toggle-combined-2 panel, ticked combo+deep and launched: regime-opt-progress-2 rendered with all 4 buttons (pause/stop/cancel/reset), Pause -> resume+paused-tag visible, Resume -> pause back, Stop -> regime-opt-result-2 with regime-opt-stopped-early-2 tag. Top-level bar: starting regime-analyze-btn with 90 Tage created regime-job-progress with pause/cancel/reset (no stop as expected for analyze kind), Pause showed '⏸ pausiert (2s)', Notfall-Reset removed the bar and toast 'Regime-Lab zurückgesetzt (1 Job(s) freigegeben)' appeared.

minor.issue: Job status after reset shows phase='Abgebrochen' instead of 'Zurückgesetzt (Notfall-Reset)'. reset_running() writes the expected phase, but the still-running worker task overwrites it to 'Abgebrochen' at the next cancel checkpoint. Minor cosmetic label divergence from the acceptance text; status transitions (cancelled, cancel=true) and active=null still work correctly.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: after emergency reset, protect the 'Zurückgesetzt (Notfall-Reset)' phase from being overwritten by the worker's subsequent cancel-checkpoint (e.g. only set 'Abgebrochen' if not already labelled as reset).
critical_code_review_comments: job_control.reset_running writes phase='Zurückgesetzt (Notfall-Reset)' but run_regime_optimizer's cancel checkpoint overrides it with 'Abgebrochen'. Consider guarding the phase overwrite when job.get('phase','').startswith('Zurückgesetzt').

rca of the issue: Not a bug – acceptance criteria met. Only the 'Abgebrochen' vs 'Zurückgesetzt (Notfall-Reset)' phase label is overwritten by the worker's cancel checkpoint after reset_running() set it. Root cause: run_regime_optimizer detects cancel==True at its next checkpoint and unconditionally sets phase='Abgebrochen', racing with reset_running(). Mitigation: in the optimizer's cancel handler, skip the phase update when the current phase already indicates a reset (starts with 'Zurückgesetzt').
